info.title: Odexa Order API
info.description: Single-product asynchronous checkout. All operations require an issuer-validated bearer JWT with audience odexa-api, realm_access.roles containing CUSTOMER, a UUID tenant_id claim, and a nonempty subject. Tenant and customer identity come exclusively from the JWT, never request headers. Prices are snapshotted from the tenant-authorized catalog, not supplied by clients. No merchant, support, or platform-admin ownership bypass is provided.

post.summary: Create or replay a single-product checkout
post.description: Requires CUSTOMER. Idempotency is scoped to (JWT tenant_id, JWT sub, Idempotency-Key). The semantic request identity is productId, quantity, and paymentMethod; JSON property order and UUID letter case do not change it. The first successful insertion returns 201; an exact retry returns 200, the same order ID and Location, and its current state. Reusing the scoped key for different intent returns 409. Concurrent requests are resolved by a database unique constraint. Persisted retries never call catalog. For a new key, catalog is authoritative for price, currency, product name and version; the original bearer JWT and correlation ID are forwarded using bounded timeouts. A catalog failure without a concurrently committed matching order returns 503 and persists no order. Checkout requires a strictly positive catalog unit price and total. Zero-amount checkout is not supported: a free product returns 422 (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE) before any new order or order.created event is persisted, so no stock is reserved. Checkout does not synchronously charge a payment method. Order creation and order.created publication via transactional outbox are atomic. Keys remain reserved while the order record is retained; no expiration is implemented.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Case-sensitive opaque key containing 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters (U+0021 through U+007E; no spaces or controls). Reuse this key when retrying the same checkout, including after an ambiguous network failure.

404.description: Product does not exist or is not accessible to this tenant (PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The scoped key already represents different intent (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT), or a new checkout targets an inactive product (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE).

422.description: Product has a zero unit price (PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE): Zero-amount checkout is not supported. No new order or order.created event is persisted and no stock is reserved.

503.description: Catalog timeout, transport failure, invalid authoritative snapshot, or upstream failure (CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE). No new order is persisted. Retrying an already persisted order does not require catalog availability.

get.description: Requires CUSTOMER. Looks up by order UUID AND JWT tenant_id AND JWT sub. Unknown IDs, cross-tenant IDs and another customer's IDs all return the same 404. Poll this resource for asynchronous state changes. Payment outcomes delivered before their inventory.reserved causation event are durably deferred: the visible status remains CREATED until that event is validated. Terminal states never move backwards or change in response to late contradictory outcomes.

200.description: Current order snapshot. Payment method, customer identity, and internal causal evidence are not exposed.

404.description: Order is absent or not owned by the authenticated customer in this tenant (ORDER_NOT_FOUND).

bearerAuth.description: OIDC issuer-validated JWT, audience odexa-api, UUID tenant_id, nonempty sub, CUSTOMER in realm_access.roles.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: UUID correlation identifier; a new UUID is generated if absent. Propagated to catalog and events. Invalid non-UUID values are rejected.

OrderLocation.description: Relative URI of the same order on creation and every exact retry.

paymentMethod.description: Opaque sandbox provider reference. pm_approved authorizes; pm_declined declines. Raw payment card data is not accepted.

totalMinor.description: Strictly positive immutable catalog unit price in minor units multiplied by quantity, with overflow checked. Zero-amount checkout is not supported.

status.description: CREATED awaits a validated reservation/rejection. PENDING_PAYMENT has reserved stock. CONFIRMED, STOCK_REJECTED and PAYMENT_FAILED are terminal. A causally deferred payment result can produce CREATED to CONFIRMED/PAYMENT_FAILED in one database transaction through the internal PENDING_PAYMENT state.

version.description: Starts at zero; increases once per domain state transition. Applying a deferred payment after its reservation increases by two. Duplicate or ignored late events do not increment it. Internal deferred evidence alone does not change the public version.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in UTC, normalized to database precision.

Problem.description: Sanitized RFC 9457 problem detail. Business problem types are https://odexa.cc/problems/{lowercase-code}. Additional transport metadata may be present.

CreatedOrder.description: New order durably created with its outbox event.

ReplayedOrder.description: Existing matching order; same ID and Location, current state; no new order or order.created event.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON/UUID, missing or invalid key, invalid correlation ID, or checkout validation error.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, including issuer/audience validation failures.

Forbidden.description: CUSTOMER role or valid tenant/customer claims are missing. Administrative roles confer no implicit access.
